name: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1921, Tamilnad Mercantile Bank (TMB) is one of the oldest private sector banks in India. It offers an array of banking and financial services to retail customers, micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs).[1]
keyPoints:
Leading Private sector Bank
Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Limited (“TMB”) is a 100-year-old leading private sector bank in India. [1] [2] As of Q1FY26, it has a branch network of 754 branches (including 169 correspondents) of which 47% are located in semi-urban areas, 16% in urban, 22% in rural, and 15% in metropolitan centers. The bank has an ATM network of 1,150.[3]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.85 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 138 days to 109 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.83% over past five years.
Dividend payout has been low at 7.52% of profits over last 3 years
